title: Fingerless Mittens
description:
Made entirely from our scraps, our 100% Australian Merino Wool Fleece Fingerless Mittens will keep your hands toasty warm. 
 
MATERIAL- 100% Merino wool fleece. Fleece is made by creating a circular knit fabric with a large terry loop on the back. Prior to final finishing it runs over a brushing machine that is a drum covered in tiny pins that break the loop and fluffs up the back.
 
FIT- One size. We made them bigger(easier to get on)
 
Machine washable on delicate cycle. Can be dried on low heat or hung to dry.

title: Neck Scarf
Zero-Waste Craft/Quilt Bundle
description:
When you purchase ONE Craft Box, ONE pound of textile waste is saved from the landfill!!

In an effort to become a waste-free company, and eliminate our textile waste, we have thoughtfully curated bundle full of Merino wool goodness with our scraps from our production.


Each bundle weighs 500 grams which is approximately 40 pieces of the softest Merino wool. Each piece is larger than your hand. Colours and fabric may vary, but we try to pack a variety from our collections in each box.


NOTE: limit to TWO per oder.


What to make:
- baby blanket
- pillowcase
- doll clothes
- napkins
- quilt
- fabric book
- face/body wipes
- patchwork products


We would love to see what you make. Please tag us on our social media pages or email us a picture of your woolly creations. Have fun!

title: Interlock Kids Thermal Bottoms
description:
Designed to fit snug, Simply Merino thermal bottoms work great as a layer under all of your kid's favourite activity gear (hockey, skiing, skating, sledding, hiking, camping, etc). For smaller sizes check out Baby Thermal Bottoms.

title: Footed Tights
description:
We've designed the best high-waisted thermal base layer leggings that you won't want to take off.

FIT- Super high-waisted without an itchy elastic band. The waist is snug, and therefore won't fall down. One length- long for tall ladies, and tight at the ankles for those who need to scrunch or fold up the hem. A gusset in the crotch to eliminate camel toe, and for comfort. They don't compress in the legs, but rather fit cozy and snug.

MATERIAL- 92% Australian Merino wool(260 gsm), and 8% Elastane to eliminate sagging of the knees. We chose a higher percentage of Merino wool, thus the material is not 100% opaque but very close. Our thermal leggings are designed to be worn as a base layer and/or loungewear.

Please refer to our fitting guide for measurements and for more photos.



Designed & Made in Canada

title: Hoodie
description:
The coziest sweatshirt you will ever own. Made with the dreamiest 100% Australian Merino wool fleece that will keep you warm all winter.
 
MATERIAL- 100% Merino wool fleece. Fleece is made by creating a circular knit fabric with a large terry loop on the back. Prior to final finishing it runs over a brushing machine that is a drum covered in tiny pins that break the loop and fluffs up the back. Both the hem, and cuffs are made with our ribbed Merino wool.
 
FIT- Relaxed fit, crew neck, long sleeve fleece with ribbed hem and cuffs. Fit is true to size, and size up for an oversized fit. NOTE: We've added length to the cuffs and band (not in Mustard & Black).
 
Machine washable on delicate cycle. Can be dried on low heat or hung to dry.

description:
Designed to fit snug, Simply Merino thermal bottoms work great as a layer under all of your kid's favourite activity gear (hockey, skiing, skating, sledding, hiking, camping, etc). The natural fabric breathes, helping control body temperature, and wicks moisture away from the skin keeping bodies dry and warm.

description:
The Simply Merino thermal tops for ages 7 -12yrs were designed with cozy Thumb Holes to keep wrists covered in cooler weather. These tops fit fairly snugly and are incredibly versatile. The natural fabric breathes, helping control body temperature, and wicks moisture away from the skin keeping bodies dry and warm.

description:

title: Baby Thermal Top
description:
Our 100% Merino wool baby undershirts are a perfect functional basic for any little one. Made from the softest Merino wool, this top regulates your baby's body temperature, keeping them warm in the winter and cool in the summer. It will also keep them dry while teething and/or from spit up, as Merino wool naturally wicks away moisture from the body. The envelop neckline is designed for easy dressing either over the head or up over the feet. 

Wear them with our 'Baby Thermal Bottoms' for extra warmth.

Fit is true to size.

title: Pocket Leggings
description:
High waisted, opaque, french-terry leggings with deep side-leg pockets. These leggings are the same pattern as our Thermal Leggings but thicker and with pockets. Super soft and warm — perfect for layering or wearing on their own. 

FIT - Not as stretchy as our Thermal Leggings. If you are in-between sizes, we suggest sizing up. Take measurements for hips and thighs rather than waist. No troublesome elastic waistband is required as fit is cozy and snug. Leg length is long for tall ladies, and tight at the ankles for those who need to scrunch or fold up the hem. 

MATERIAL - 94 % Australian Merino wool. 6% Elastane.  

Please refer to our fitting guide for measurements.

Designed & Made in Canada

title: Kids Pajamas
description:
Simply Merino pyjamas are the reason we got into this business. We were looking for a PJ set that was naturally fire resistant (unlike most synthetic pyjamas that are chemically treated) and couldn't find anything on the local market, so decided to fill that gap ourselves.

Merino is a natural fabric that breathes, keeping your child's body dry and comfortable as well as regulating their body temperature, keeping them cool when its warm and warm when its cool. It does this while being incredibly soft on even the most sensitive skin.
 
Our limited Tie-Dye sets are ice dyed with low impact dye by our friend Wildflower Dyes. Wash normally, colour does not run.
 
Designed to be pyjamas, these two-piece sets are also great as thermal under layers. The top is great under a t-shirt, and the bottom as leggings under a skirt.

title: Infant Gown
description:
Simply Merino infant gowns are designed to keep life simple during those first few months. Lighter than a sleep sack, and great for all genders, the draw-string bottom creates that secure feeling babies like, allowing their legs to comfortably curl up. During late night diaper changes, the draw-string makes it a quick and easy change (no need to fumble with snaps or zippers). Sleeves are cuffed and can be pulled over to create a mitt—keeping your little one from scratching themselves. 

As your baby grows, remove the drawstring and use it as a night shirt or a dress with our baby leggings. Both super cute!
All hems and bindings are double stitched for durability, and the side seams are flat stitched so there is absolutely no irritation. We use soft silk labels for extra comfort.

Fit is true to size.
